name: Kirishima Shunran
source:
Wife of the eldest son, Daigo. A radiant beauty with a healthy, athletic charm, she met Daigo in college. Her background in rhythmic gymnastics makes her incredibly flexible — both physically and mentally. She cracks crude jokes on par with her husband, but her dirtiest traits are all talk and no action.
